lex:
νομικός, -ή, -όν
(νόμος), [in LXX: 4Ma.5:4 * ;]
__1. relating to law: μάχαι, Tit.3:9.
__2. learned in the law; as subst., ὁ ν. (EV, lawyer): Mat.22:35, Luk.10:25, Tit.3:13; pl., Luk.7:30 11:45-46, 52 14:3 (cf. MM, xvii).†
SYN.: γραμματεύς, q.v

strongs.def: according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law
